delivery_target: Future consumer of tcb_arch_detype' in detype_invs or related proofs that prove valid_arch_tcb preservation without a concrete ko_at witness
new_lemma:
lemma tcb_arch_detype'[detype_invs_proofs]:
  "valid_arch_tcb (tcb_arch t) s
      \<Longrightarrow> valid_arch_tcb (tcb_arch t) (detype (untyped_range cap) s)"
  apply (clarsimp simp: valid_arch_tcb_def)
  done
rationale: The original proof body `apply (clarsimp simp: valid_arch_tcb_def)` never mentions ko_at, erule, frule, drule or any rule that consumes `ko_at (TCB t) p s`. The simplification of valid_arch_tcb_def on ARM expands to a trivially-true condition (ARM valid_arch_tcb holds unconditionally or depends only on the tcb_arch field), so the ko_at witness is structurally unused.
strengthening_claim: valid_arch_tcb (tcb_arch t) s ==> (ko_at (TCB t) p s \<and> valid_arch_tcb (tcb_arch t) s)
